newsitem.title: UK: QUIET EUROBONDS AWAIT CME JUNK BONDS PRICING.
newsitem.headline: QUIET EUROBONDS AWAIT CME JUNK BONDS PRICING.

text.p: Players were awaiting the pricing of two junk bonds for Central European Media amid an otherwise featureless primary market session on Thursday.
CME was due to price the two bonds, a $100 million seven-year and a 100 million mark seven-year, at a 300-325 basis points yield over respective government bond markets during the New York session.
The Morgan Stanley-led notes have been rated B1/B+.
Central European Media owns and operates national and regional private television stations in Germany, Poland, the Czech Republic, the Slovak Republic, Slovenia and Romania.
Other new issue activity was confined to a few small increases on recently launched deals and a Xerox unit setting a $147.6 million unlisted deal with a 5.40 percent semi-annual coupon.
Such issues, on which Kokusai and Merrill Lynch were joint leads, are sold to Japanese investors on the basis of their yield pick-up versus yen bonds.
